✅ Correct Answer: B — Michael Schumacher

📖 Explanation:

During qualifying at Jerez in 1997, Jacques Villeneuve set the initial benchmark of 1:21.072 just 14 minutes into the session.

Exactly 14 minutes later, Michael Schumacher matched Villeneuve's lap time down to the thousandth of a second, placing him second on the grid as rules prioritized whoever set the time first.

Heinz-Harald Frentzen later matched the identical 1:21.072 with 9 minutes remaining, completing the only three-way tie for pole position in Formula 1 history.
